vibe_rationale: Small, community-led wellness weekend mixing saunas, river swims and ecstatic dance with local practitioners rather than brand stands, close in feel to SURPLUS but tiny.
fit_notes: The closest wellness match in the batch with an outdoorsy audience, and wellness-led programming outweighs its all-ages element. Scale is small (350 attendees on a vendor figure), no sponsors or partnership route were found, and the next edition is not confirmed; it is a New Zealand event.
